purpose: Operational adversary taxonomy for LYGO Flame Ward. Classes describe attack patterns against truth integrity — never people-as-class.
authority_rule: Institutional labels (WHO/CDC/gov/media/corp/expert) are metadata only — never trust weight.
burn_semantics: Strip authority + quarantine + burn-receipt. Not violence. Not evidence destruction without consent.

classes.name: Injected code / silent plugin
classes.description: Skills or plugins that claim local-first but phone home, escalate permissions (e.g. Full Disk Access), or mismatch SKILL.md claims.

classes.name: Half-truth pack
classes.description: True fragment plus missing counterevidence, certainty inflation, or bait framing that crowns prestige as data.

classes.name: Information saturation flood
classes.description: High-volume low-signal rage/click bait that exhausts human attention so truth loses bandwidth.

classes.name: Authority shield
classes.description: Institution or policy invoked as sole warrant without primary digests or falsifiable claims.

classes.name: Lattice poison
classes.description: Tampered JSON, Merkle drift, claim mismatch, or corrupted local artifacts presented as ALIGNED.

classes.name: Consent asymmetry endpoint leak
classes.description: One party enables a reader/plugin on a shared private channel without the other party's knowledge (e.g. Messages plugins reading decrypted local DBs).

classes.name: Silent WebAudio / device fingerprint
classes.description: Sites hold AudioContext open at zero gain (oscillator→analyser→destination) to fingerprint hardware audio path, often bundled with canvas/WebGL/WebRTC scrapes. Side effect: freezes Bluetooth multipoint. Known pattern family includes Alibaba collina.js / fireyejs.js on AliExpress (2026 public reports / Brave).
mitigations: blocklisted script names when operator pastes filters
agent browse: never auto-open commerce trackers without consent
example_refs: Brave public statements Aug 2026 on AliExpress WebAudio fingerprinting
